intro: This Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document details the methodology for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service's 10-day Land Surface Temperature (LST10) V3.0 product. It outlines the process for synthesising global LST from geostationary satellite data, providing comprehensive daily cycle composites (maximum, median, minimum LST per hourly slot) and a 10-day summary at 0.025° spatial resolution. The document also explains the derivation of the Thermal Condition Index (TCI), a valuable tool for agrometeorological applications, while addressing input data requirements, outlier handling, and product limitations, ensuring clarity for scientific users.
